, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the date format by “normalizing” 11 September 1962 to the U.S. MM/DD/YYYY format as 11/09/1962 and then stating it as November 9, 1962. This confuses DD/MM with MM/DD; the correct MM/DD conversion should be 09/11/1962.
